main_text.l: CVm monachi fratres sint quos vel cadida vestisVel nigra, vel gemino mixta colore tegit:Quanta tamen miseros agitat discordia fratres!Quàm non fraterna fœdera pacis amant!Non ita germanum reducem trux ederat Atreus,Atrea viscceribus non satur ille suis.Mitius Oedipodæ soboles exarsit in iras,Mitior indomitas incitat ira feras,Euentu ò simili cessent fraterna simultas,Et dirimat caluos exitus iste patres.Dentibus & gladiis in mutua funera currant,Ira nec extremi cessét in igne rogi.

DIcunt Grammatici suos Cucullos,Dicunt rhetores horridos Cucullos:Et quisquis Latias femel CamœnasVel primus modò contigit labellis.Sic olim in Satyris Cucullum AquinasEt durum & venetum poeta dixit.Verùm Pantalabus senerus illeFranciscanus, & horridus sophista,Clamosa & Sophia senex magister,Dicit perpetuò suam Cucullam,Laudat perpetuò suam Cucullam,Per sacram quoque deierat Cucullam,Per sacram quoque peierat Cucullam:Suósque edocuit Cuculliones,Sacra ipem sibi ponere in Cucula.Prudens id facit ille, ne quid erres,Non lapsu temerario loquendi,

page.notes: Page is a verse page with some faded and stained areas; a few words are uncertain, notably "Cuculliones" and "Cucula"/"Cucullam" line endings, and "senerus" and "sophista" in the Pantalabus passage. Some letters ("Atreus", "exitus", "simultas") are rendered as printed but may be slightly blurred. The stanza-initial capitals C, D are large woodcut-style initials. Line breaks within stanzas are marked with br for the printed lines.
